environment.storage_scope: local filesystem; OS cache not flushed

limitations: research-only prototype; no production storage API
reopen-coldish does not flush the OS page cache
logical_value_bytes_fetched is returned MDBX value length, not physical disk I/O

crash-recovery lifecycle is a separate follow-up measurement
